rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone obstinately refuses to change or admit they are wrong.

example.english: You know you were wrong, but you’re still so perverse and refuse to admit it.
example.traditional: 你明知自己做錯咗都仲咁固執，死口唔認。
example.jyutping: nei5 ming4 zi1 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 zo2 dou1 zung6 gam3 gu3 zap1 sei2 hau2 m4 jing6

rows.note: Use this for something literally crooked or, colloquially, for a person or idea seen as morally warped or bad.

example.english: He sold out his friends for money; he’s truly perverse.
example.traditional: 佢為咗錢出賣朋友，個人真係歪到離譜。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 cin4 ceot1 maai6 pang4 jau5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 waai1 dou3 lei4 pou2

rows.note: Choose this when the behavior, result, or situation is oddly contrary or vexing rather than simply stubborn.

example.english: The ending of this film is so perverse that it leaves you baffled.
example.traditional: 呢部戲個結局古怪到令人摸唔着頭腦。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 hei3 go3 git3 guk6 gu2 gwaai3 dou3 ling6 jan4 mo2 m4 zoek6 tau4 nou5
